Method of Attack: Abuse of Cloudflare Tunnels to generate encrypted HTTPS connections from compromised devices
Establishing and maintaining hidden access to compromised networks
Secretly transmitting data from victim’s devices
Using QUIC on port 7844 for HTTPS connection and data transfer
Using Cloudflare’s ‘TryCloudflare’ option without creating an account
Maliciously using Cloudflare’s ‘Private Networks’ capability to access internal IP addresses
Attack Vector: Execution of a single command from the victim’s device to establish a clandestine communication channel
Exploitation of Cloudflare Tunnels for encrypted communication
Indicators of Compromise: File hashes connected with ‘Cloudflare’ client updates
DNS queries related to unauthorized Cloudflare network usage
